blocks.text: Six times x is six x. Six times two is twelve. So six x plus twelve.
The minus sign in front means times negative one. It changes the sign of both terms: negative x plus five.
Negative three times two x is negative six x. Negative three times negative one is positive three.
x times x is x squared. x times negative four is negative four x.
Every expression now has its expanded form. Multiply every term inside, and watch the signs.
